decisions.reason: After another year the firm has learned more, but as a low-cost carpet close to the core range it still makes sense to keep the option open unless demand clearly disappoints.
Its overlap with other recently introduced carpets raises portfolio-pruning risk, yet it remains inexpensive and close enough to the established offer to justify continued market presence for now.
The corner bench is more niche and likely costlier to carry than the carpets, so withdrawal risk is higher, but it still builds on existing capabilities and can be given more time to prove demand.
This carpet remains easy to maintain as part of the assortment, though the firm is now more likely to rationalize among similar designs if its distinct market appeal does not become clearer.
The swivel shell chair line fits the firm's push into flexible workplace concepts and, as a broader product line, still offers enough strategic option value to continue.
